tasks.subject: Task 1: Relocate runtime source into the SwiftGodot target
tasks.description:
Move all hand-written SwiftGodotRuntime source under Sources/SwiftGodot/Runtime/ and remove every in-source reference to the SwiftGodotRuntime module.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Sources/SwiftGodotRuntime/", "Sources/SwiftGodot/SwiftGodotExports.swift", "Sources/SwiftGodot/GodotInterface.swift", "Sources/SwiftGodot/Extensions/NodeExtensions.swift", "Sources/SwiftGodot/VariantConvertibeNode.swift", ".gitignore"], "verifyCommand": "! grep -rn 'import SwiftGodotRuntime' Sources/ && ! test -d Sources/SwiftGodotRuntime && echo OK", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Sources/SwiftGodotRuntime/ no longer exists", "runtime source lives under Sources/SwiftGodot/Runtime/", "no import SwiftGodotRuntime in Sources/SwiftGodot", "VariantConvertibeNode.swift has no SwiftGodotRuntime. qualifier", ".gitignore references only Sources/SwiftGodot/_generated"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Merge the targets in Package.swift
tasks.description:
Make SwiftGodot a single self-contained target in the development manifest; remove the SwiftGodotRuntime target and products.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Package.swift"], "verifyCommand": "swift package dump-package > /dev/null && echo OK", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no SwiftGodotRuntime target", "no SwiftGodotRuntime/SwiftGodotRuntimeStatic product", "SwiftGodot target depends only on GDExtension with union of flags+plugins"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Merge the targets in Package.distribution.swift
tasks.description:
Apply the same target/product merge to the release manifest.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Package.distribution.swift"], "verifyCommand": "cp Package.swift /tmp/pkg.bak && cp Package.distribution.swift Package.swift && swift package dump-package > /dev/null && echo OK; cp /tmp/pkg.bak Package.swift", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no SwiftGodotRuntime target or product", "SwiftGodot target depends only on GDExtension with union of flags"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Collapse the code generator plugin config
tasks.description:
CodeGeneratorPlugin generates builtins + every class into the single SwiftGodot target with no import preamble; remove the SwiftGodotRuntime case.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Plugins/CodeGeneratorPlugin/plugin.swift"], "verifyCommand": "grep -n 'import SwiftGodotRuntime' Plugins/CodeGeneratorPlugin/plugin.swift", "acceptanceCriteria": ["SwiftGodot config generates all classes + knownBuiltin with preamble nil", "SwiftGodotRuntime case removed"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Stop the generator emitting SwiftGodotRuntime-qualified code
tasks.description:
Generated Swift no longer module-qualifies symbols with SwiftGodotRuntime.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Generator/Generator/TypeHelpers.swift", "Generator/Generator/BuiltinGen.swift"], "verifyCommand": "! grep -rn 'SwiftGodotRuntime\\.' Generator/ && echo OK", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no SwiftGodotRuntime.-qualified references in Generator/", "@_spi(SwiftGodotRuntimePrivate) attributes left intact"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Update the macro library to emit SwiftGodot.
tasks.description:
Macro expansions reference SwiftGodot.* instead of SwiftGodotRuntime.*.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Sources/SwiftGodotMacroLibrary/MacroExport.swift", "Sources/SwiftGodotMacroLibrary/MacroCallable.swift", "Sources/SwiftGodotMacroLibrary/MacroGodot.swift"], "verifyCommand": "! grep -rn 'SwiftGodotRuntime' Sources/SwiftGodotMacroLibrary/ && echo OK", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no SwiftGodotRuntime. emitted by the macro library"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Update the macro test fixtures
tasks.description:
The 68 expected macro-expansion fixtures match the new SwiftGodot.-qualified output.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Tests/SwiftGodotMacrosTests/Resources/"], "verifyCommand": "! grep -rln 'SwiftGodotRuntime' Tests/SwiftGodotMacrosTests/Resources/ && echo OK", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no fixture contains SwiftGodotRuntime."]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: Update test targets and the test runner
tasks.description:
Test sources import/reference SwiftGodot instead of SwiftGodotRuntime; test runner stops listing the removed product.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Tests/SwiftGodotTestExtension/WrappedTests.swift", "Tests/SwiftGodotTestExtension/TestObjectCleanup.swift", "Tests/SwiftGodotTestExtension/MarshalTests.swift", "Tests/SwiftGodotTestExtension/MacroIntegrationTests.swift", "Sources/SwiftGodotTestRunner/SwiftGodotTestRunner.swift"], "verifyCommand": "! grep -rn 'SwiftGodotRuntime' Tests/ Sources/SwiftGodotTestRunner/ && echo OK", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no import SwiftGodotRuntime in Tests/", "MacroIntegrationTests references SwiftGodot.FastVariant", "test runner arrays no longer list SwiftGodotRuntime"]}
```

tasks.description:
Prove the merged package compiles and the existing test suite passes.

```json:metadata
{"files": [], "verifyCommand": "swift build && swift test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["swift build succeeds", "swift test succeeds including SwiftGodotMacrosTests"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 10: Update the release framework scripts
tasks.description:
Release pipeline scripts build, stage, and package only the single SwiftGodot module.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/build-distribution-products", "scripts/release", "scripts/make-swiftgodot-framework", "scripts/test-make-swiftgodot-framework"], "verifyCommand": "bash -n scripts/build-distribution-products scripts/release scripts/make-swiftgodot-framework scripts/test-make-swiftgodot-framework && bash scripts/test-make-swiftgodot-framework", "acceptanceCriteria": ["build-distribution-products stages only SwiftGodot, copies generated/+generated-builtin/, one xcodebuild scheme", "release no longer requires SwiftGodotRuntime prebuilt artifacts", "make-swiftgodot-framework no longer stages SwiftGodotRuntime.swiftmodule", "test-make-swiftgodot-framework drops the runtime token"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 11: Update the release workflow and README
tasks.description:
CI no longer packs SwiftGodotRuntime build products; docs no longer advertise a SwiftGodotRuntime product.

```json:metadata
{"files": [".github/workflows/release.yml", "README.md"], "verifyCommand": "! grep -rn 'SwiftGodotRuntime' .github/workflows/release.yml README.md && echo OK", "acceptanceCriteria": ["release.yml has no SwiftGodotRuntime reference", "README.md has no SwiftGodotRuntime reference"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 12: Full release-build verification
tasks.description:
Confirm the merged xcframework builds and its SwiftGodot.swiftinterface does not import SwiftGodotRuntime.

```json:metadata
{"files": [], "verifyCommand": "SWIFT_GODOT_NODEPLOY=1 scripts/release ... then grep/find the xcframework", "acceptanceCriteria": ["scripts/release completes with SWIFT_GODOT_NODEPLOY=1", "no .swiftinterface imports SwiftGodotRuntime", "no SwiftGodotRuntime.swiftmodule inside the xcframework"]}
```
